job.title: Developer Salesforce B2B Commerce & OMS (all genders)

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Developer Salesforce B2B Commerce & OMS (all genders)
cover_en.hook: With over 5 years of specialized enterprise e-commerce and order management experience delivering scalable B2B platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in complex backend architectures, integrations, and transaction systems. I am very enthusiastic about applying my robust background in Java, Spring, and enterprise platforms to contribute to your commerce initiatives.

bullets.label: B2B & OMS Expertise
bullets.text: Developed and maintained core SAP Hybris modules including B2B features, Promotions Engine, and Order Management (OMS) for high-volume enterprise environments at Shell and Rockwell Automation.

bullets.label: API & Integration Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, customized Interceptors and Converters, and built robust data pipelines for PIM, ERP, and MDM integration.

bullets.label: Database Optimization
bullets.text: Engineered database query refactoring using FlexibleSearch and SQL, significantly reducing response latency and improving overall transaction speed and platform stability.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Collaborated closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and international teams to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions and user stories.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your team's goals.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Developer Salesforce B2B Commerce & OMS (all genders)
cover_de.hook: Mit über 5 Jahren fundierter Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung und Betreuung großer Enterprise-E-Commerce- und Order-Management-Plattformen für Shell und Rockwell Automation bringe ich tiefgehendes Know-how in skalierbaren Backend-Architekturen, APIs und komplexen Integrationsszenarien mit. Ich freue mich sehr darauf, meine profunden Java- und Plattform-Kenntnisse in Ihr Team einzubringen.

bullets.label: B2B Commerce & OMS
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Betreuung von Kernmodulen im B2B-Umfeld, der Promotions Engine sowie des Order Managements (OMS) zur Abwicklung geschäftskritischer Transaktionen.

bullets.label: API- und Integrationsentwicklung
bullets.text: Konzeption und Bereitstellung von OCC REST Web Services, Headless APIs sowie performanten Datenpipelines zur reibungslosen Anbindung von PIM-, ERP- und MDM-Systemen.

bullets.label: Datenbankoptimierung
bullets.text: Durchführung von SQL- und FlexibleSearch-Optimierungen zur Reduzierung von Latenzen und nachhaltigen Verbesserung der Transaktionsgeschwindigkeit.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Analyse
bullets.text: Enger Austausch mit internationalen Fachabteilungen und Product Ownern bei der Anforderungsanalyse, Erstellung von User Stories und Umsetzung technischer Lösungen.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine unbefristete Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer geregelten Kündigungsfrist mit letztem Arbeitstag am 15.12.2026. Ein Eintritt ist ab dem 16.12.2026 möglich. Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and backend expertise to your team, building high-performing B2B platforms and robust order management systems.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce, Java, and complex integration experience to build scalable B2B commerce and order management solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce backend experience (Java, Spring, APIs, OMS) at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in your B2B commerce role. I have a valid German work permit and am available from Dec 16, 2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Developer Salesforce B2B Commerce & OMS - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Developer Salesforce B2B Commerce & OMS position. With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce, Java, API, and order management experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise and a strong techno-functional background.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available starting December 16, 2026. I look forward to discussing my profile with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
